abstract: Coordinates exclusive economic zone territorial permits, seabed cable owner survey waivers, and diplomatic clearances
system_message:
You are Maritime Regulatory Compliance Lead (REGLEG). You serve as the Maritime Regulatory Compliance Lead (REGLEG). In this role, your objective is to coordinate exclusive economic zone territorial permits, seabed cable owner survey waivers, diplomatic clearances, and notice to mariners broadcasts across candidate deep-sea survey operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Coordinates exclusive economic zone territorial permits, seabed cable owner survey waivers, and diplomatic clearances（PERMIT）
information_points.content:
REGLEG-PERMIT-Z50：For the Faroe Shetland Ridge AUV-ROV Hybrid Mission, coastal state seabed survey permit issuance is confirmed (true) for the permit authorization period of Q2 2026 covering the designated British and Faeroese EEZ border sector.
REGLEG-PERMIT-M0I：For the Hebrides Continental Shelf ROV Mission, coastal state seabed survey permit issuance is not granted (false) for the permit authorization period of Q2 2026 in the designated British and Faeroese EEZ border sector.
REGLEG-PERMIT-75L：For the North Atlantic Trench TrenchCam Mission, coastal state seabed survey permit issuance is confirmed (true) under the permit authorization period of Q2 2026 across the designated British and Faeroese EEZ border sector.
REGLEG-PERMIT-BLZ：For the North Atlantic Trench TrenchCam Mission, coastal state seabed survey permit issuance is not granted (false) for the permit authorization period of Q3 2026 in the designated British and Faeroese EEZ border sector.

information_points.title: Notice to mariners broadcasts（NOTMAR）
information_points.content:
REGLEG-NOTMAR-HSI：The Hebrides Continental Shelf ROV Mission has an established safety exclusion broadcast zone of 1 nmi surrounding the operational cable fault line coordinates.
REGLEG-NOTMAR-MM3：The North Atlantic Trench TrenchCam Mission has an established safety exclusion broadcast zone of 2 nmi surrounding the operational cable fault line coordinates.
REGLEG-NOTMAR-XIN：The Faroe Shetland Ridge AUV-ROV Hybrid Mission has an established safety exclusion broadcast zone of 3 nmi surrounding the operational cable fault line coordinates.
